form.title: PURCHASE AND SALE AGREEMENT
form.section: This Purchase and Sale Agreement is made between (the "Buyer") and (the "Seller"), through their respective brokers.
The property subject to this Agreement is located at , Municipality of , identified as Catastro Number and Registry Entry .
The purchase price is , payable as follows: a deposit of upon execution of this Agreement, with the balance payable at closing.
Closing shall take place on or before at a time and place mutually agreed by the parties.
Seller shall deliver good and marketable title, free and clear of all liens and encumbrances, and shall provide a standard title insurance commitment at Seller's expense.
Real estate taxes and municipal assessments shall be prorated as of the date of closing. Seller shall pay all taxes due through the day of closing.
The parties shall bear their respective closing costs in accordance with prevailing custom and practice, including notarial and registry fees as provided by law.
Risk of loss or damage to the Property shall remain with Seller until the closing, after which it shall pass to Buyer.
In the event of Buyer's default, the deposit may be retained by Seller as liquidated damages. In the event of Seller's default, Buyer may terminate this Agreement and receive a refund of the deposit.
All notices required under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered to the parties at the addresses stated herein.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico.
Describe the financing commitment, lender, loan amount and the deadline to obtain the financing commitment letter.
Describe whether the appraisal is waived, the survey requirements and the inspection period and resolution.
Additional negotiated terms of the transaction.
Special conditions negotiated by the parties.

Possession shall be delivered at closing, broom-clean, free of occupants and personal property not included in the sale, unless the parties agree otherwise in writing. Keys, codes and access devices shall be delivered at closing.

All fixtures permanently attached to the Property are included. Appliances, furnishings and other personal property are included only if listed in Additional Terms. Seller shall not remove included items after the date of this Agreement.

Except as required by law or expressly warranted in this Agreement, the Property is sold in its present as-is condition. Buyer has had, or will have during the inspection period, a reasonable opportunity to inspect.

Buyer may inspect the Property within forty-eight hours before closing to confirm that it is in substantially the same condition as on the date of this Agreement, ordinary wear excepted, and that agreed repairs have been completed.
Taxes, rents, HOA dues, utilities and similar recurring charges shall be prorated as of the closing date. Prepaid items and deposits transferable to Buyer shall be credited accordingly.

If the Property is subject to a homeowners or condominium association, Seller shall provide the current documents, budget, and statement of account. Buyer shall apply for membership as required by the association.

Seller shall maintain utility service through closing. Buyer shall arrange transfer of service effective the closing date. Outstanding utility charges remain Seller's responsibility through the day of closing.

Each party may retain independent counsel. Closing shall be conducted before a Puerto Rico notary public. Notarial and registry fees shall be allocated as provided under Closing Costs, unless amended in Additional Terms.

The parties shall cooperate with any withholding or reporting required under applicable Puerto Rico and federal tax law in connection with the transfer, including nonresident withholding if applicable.
Buyer may not assign this Agreement without Seller's prior written consent, except to an entity controlled by Buyer. No assignment shall release Buyer from liability.
This Agreement, including any addenda signed by the parties, constitutes the entire agreement and supersedes all prior negotiations. Amendments must be in writing and signed by Buyer and Seller.
This Agreement may be signed in counterparts, each of which is an original. Electronic delivery of a signed counterpart is effective.
If any provision is held unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue in full force. The unenforceable provision shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it enforceable.
Time is of the essence of this Agreement. Deadlines that fall on a weekend or legal holiday in Puerto Rico run to the next business day.
